name: The Stair-Taper
description: A stub of thin white tallow candle a hand-span long, burned down at one end, notched down its side at even spaces: a notch to every landing of a stair. It came out of the Vigil Light's smoke into your hand as Kindleby's fire caught, warm as the ember. To anybody else it's a candle-end. To you it hums the way a Remnant hums, and what it hums is yours: cold stone turning always to the left, a notch under your thumb, and someone a turn above you saying a name you know is yours, that doesn't come. Nothing you would ever burn. Not yet.
